youtube.title: New grid shot: all 8 loop looks in one shot, each label from the approved copy
youtube.description:
Eight looks. One shot: the new grid shot in funkbox, cells arriving one per beat.
Each label is a line of the approved copy; the text audit checked all 15 on-screen strings: exact. Rendered in 62 s on a 4-core CPU, no GPU, no video model.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
